title: PKI login step 2 — sign the nonce, bind the wallet, receive the cookie
description: The bank signs the nonce from mock-auth-hp-02 with the P-256 private key matching its Central-Bank-issued X.509 participant certificate and POSTs the DER signature (hex) together with the certificate PEM. Only now are the access_token and refresh_token cookies set.
notes: Public endpoint (security: []) — the signature over the nonce is the credential. nonce_signature_hex and cert_pem below are placeholder strings, not a real signature or certificate; this kit never ships key material. Binding fails if the participant's KYC status is not ACTIVE. Undocumented upstream: this handler can also answer 403 and 500.
